rejection_summary.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
rejection_summary.reason: The 118-minute buddy action-comedy has frequent attacks and a major Amsterdam boat-and-road chase, but whole-film assessments diverge sharply: RogerEbert.com describes extensive vehicle mayhem while The Guardian and The Prague Reporter emphasize detours, uneven pacing and the strongest action arriving around the 90–100-minute climax. The conflicting evidence does not establish sufficiently sustained action density across the entire runtime to advance confidently today; avoid equating the impressive final chase with the whole film.
